articles.title: Judge Says Trump’s Mail-In Voting Rules Can Stay—For Now
articles.summary: A judge in Washington, D.C., decided not to stop President Trump’s order that could make voting by mail harder. But the order hasn’t started yet, so the fight isn’t over. Critics say it’s unfair and could block some people from voting.

articles.title: Latvia Gets a New Leader After Drones Cause a Government Shake-Up
articles.summary: Stray drones—likely from Ukraine—flew into Latvia and caused a big argument. The prime minister quit, and now a new government is in charge. They promise to keep the country safe and stick with Europe and NATO.

articles.title: Prices Are Rising Fast—and Americans’ Wallets Are Feeling the Squeeze
articles.summary: Inflation hit 3.8% in April, the highest in three years. Gas, food, and clothes are all getting more expensive, while people’s paychecks aren’t keeping up. Some leaders say it’s no big deal, but families are struggling.
